steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates explained Lamb Weston as a French fry supplier in a category with huge demand, citing that 42% of restaurant menus worldwide and 60% in the US included fries.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2023, a guest on Equity Mates described the US French fry market as an oligopoly that competed rationally on price, and said Lamb Weston’s margins had been hit by a bad Colorado River harvest but could improve after a strong Columbia River Basin harvest.

episode.title: We review the 16 stocks pitched at the Sohn Hearts & Minds conference

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In November 2023, a guest on Equity Mates said Lamb Weston’s share price had been beaten down by a poor harvest and Ozempic fears, and argued that better harvest volumes might lift margins, which they saw as a reason its valuation could change.
